basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old music enthusiast from Minneapolis, diving into Reddit to connect with others who share my love for classic trance music and quirky humor. I'm a graphic designer by day, which gives me a lot of flexibility to browse Reddit during evenings and late nights. I'm single, and I love spending my weekends exploring local record stores and attending electronic music events. I recently moved to the Twin Cities, so I'm also on the lookout for local tips and community events.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm self-taught in graphic design, having started with online tutorials and practice projects. My passion for electronic music has also led me to learn a bit about music production, mostly through YouTube and online forums.
